definition_zh: 兵营；军营驻地；（临时）宿营地
definition_en: a group of military buildings or quarters, especially permanent barracks or a temporary camp
core_image: 一座按棋盘格划开的营地：一排排营房整齐分块，像被切成小块的领土
scene: 列车驶过城郊，铁轨旁是一排排刷着灰漆的低矮营房。The troops returned to the cantonment before the monsoon.
sceneCN: 这里 cantonment 是「兵营」（第 1 个义项：成建制的军营驻地）；句意是雨季来临前部队撤回了兵营。

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「分驻；把部队分配驻扎」
同根名词，义为「州；行政区；（纹章）方块角区」

senses.title: Permanent military quarters
senses.definition: a permanent settlement of military buildings and housing, often with civilian administration attached
senses.definitionCN: 由军营建筑与住房组成的常设驻地，常附带民政管理
senses.example: The cantonment had its own school and hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 这个兵营有自己的学校和医院。
senses.why: Troops are cantoned, divided into assigned blocks, and the block itself becomes the settlement.
senses.whyCN: 部队被「分块驻扎」，这些区块本身便固化成营区。

senses.title: A temporary camp for troops
senses.definition: the quartering of soldiers in a place for a season, especially winter quarters
senses.definitionCN: 军队在某地按季节驻扎，尤指越冬营地
senses.example: The army broke cantonment when the thaw came.
senses.exampleCN: 解冻之后大军拔营出发。
senses.why: The seasonal sense keeps the verb alive: the army is divided into assigned corners for the winter.
senses.whyCN: 季节义保留了动词的生命：军队被分派到各处角落过冬。

intro.en: Cantonment comes from French cantonner, to divide into corners or quarters, from canton, a corner, a word of Gaulish and Latin ancestry.
intro.cn: cantonment 来自法语 cantonner（划分角落、分块驻扎），其词基 canton（角落）一般认为出自高卢语并经拉丁语中转。

items.en: The root *kan- relates to a corner or edge, the meeting point of two sides.
items.cn: 词根 *kan- 与角落、边缘相关，即两边的交接处。

items.en: Gaulish can listed corner-shaped land divisions; Romance canton meant a corner or district.
items.cn: 高卢语的 can 指角状的地块划分；罗曼语 canton 意为角落或地区。

items.en: French cantonner meant to quarter troops in districts, dividing a region into assigned blocks.
items.cn: 法语 cantonner 意为把部队分驻各区，将一片区域划成指定地块。

items.en: English took cantonment in the eighteenth century for troops' quarters, especially in colonial India.
items.cn: 英语于十八世纪借入 cantonment，指部队驻地，尤用于英属印度。

items.en: It survives chiefly in South Asian usage and military history, where cantonments remain named districts.
items.cn: 如今该词主要留存于南亚用法与军事史中，那里的营区仍是正式地名。

note.en: Cantonment shares its corner-root with place and flag words that are easy to tangle together.
note.cn: cantonment 与一批同出「角落」词根的地名、旗帜词汇容易纠缠。

entries.definition: A corner; a small state such as those of Switzerland; the upper corner square of a flag.
entries.definitionCN: 角落；行政区（如瑞士诸州）；旗帜左上角的方块区。

entries.definition: The city long called Canton in English, from the same corner word via Portuguese.
entries.definitionCN: 广州旧称 Canton（广东），经葡萄牙语出自同一「角落」词。

entries.definition: Quartered or divided into cantons, the verb behind the noun.
entries.definitionCN: 被分块驻扎的；被划分为行政区的，是该名词背后的动词形式。

entries.definition: The act of holding something within limits; sounds close but from contain.
entries.definitionCN: 遏制、围堵，发音相近但源自 contain。

entries.definition: The troops stationed in a fort or town, or the post itself.
entries.definitionCN: 驻军；要塞或城镇中的驻防地。

entries.definition: Buildings housing soldiers, the plain everyday word.
A camp, especially temporary, without the administrative flavor.
entries.definitionCN: 营地，尤指临时营地，不带行政色彩。

entries.definition: Assigned living space, including military lodgings.
entries.definitionCN: 分配的住所，含军人宿舍义。

entries.definition: The sending out of troops from their base, the leaving of the cantonment.
entries.definitionCN: 部队从基地派出，即离开 cantonment 的动作。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the corner root and the gridded camp image.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕「角落」词根与「棋盘营地」画面的记忆钩子。

normal.en: Root picture: French cantonner cuts land into corners and assigns troops to each.
normal.cn: 词根画面：法语 cantonner 把土地切成角落，再把部队分驻其中。

normal.en: Swiss bridge: canton names the Swiss states, the most famous corner-word descendants.
normal.cn: 瑞士桥梁：canton 指瑞士诸州，是「角落」词最著名的后裔。

normal.en: Flag corner: the canton of a flag is its upper-left square, same word.
normal.cn: 旗帜一角：flag 的 canton 指左上方方块，同一个词。

normal.en: Colony note: cantonment survives as the official word for military districts in India and Pakistan.
normal.cn: 殖民注脚：在印度和巴基斯坦，cantonment 仍是军区的正式说法。

normal.en: Season hook: winter cantonment means troops settle in for the cold months.
normal.cn: 季节钩子：winter cantonment 指部队入营过冬。

abstract.en: A map divided by blue pencil into neat squares, each square assigned a sleeping regiment.
abstract.cn: 地图被蓝铅笔划成整齐的方块，每个方块里住着一个团的士兵。

abstract.en: Rows of identical gray roofs seen from a passing train, chimneys standing to attention.
abstract.cn: 掠过车窗的一排排灰色屋顶，烟囱立正列队。

abstract.en: A Swiss flag with its white cross in the corner square, a corner that became a country.
abstract.cn: 瑞士国旗左上角的白十字：一个长成了国家的「角落」。

examples.en: The colonial cantonment was laid out on a strict grid.
examples.cn: 这座殖民时期的兵营按严格的棋盘格布局。

examples.en: Shops grew up along the road outside the cantonment walls.
examples.cn: 营墙外的道路两旁渐渐聚起了商铺。

examples.en: The regiment went into cantonment for the winter.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「看图门」——看地图找营门：整片营地被划成一个个方格，格格都是驻军营房；联想瑞士地图上的一块块州（canton），每块就是一个角落。

root: 源自法语 cantonner（分块、分驻），词基 canton（角落、行政区）一般认为出自高卢语 can（角落），经拉丁语及罗曼诸语传承。名词 cantonment 由动词 cantonner 加 -ment 构成，指部队分驻之地。同根词有瑞士的 canton（州）、旗帜的 canton（左上角区）、广州旧称 Canton。十八世纪随英国殖民军事进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: From dividing land into corners the word names both permanent military districts and seasonal troop camps.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「把土地划成角落」出发，词义兼指常设军营区与季节性宿营。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: land cut into assigned corners, soldiers settled into each block.
core.cn: 核心意象：土地被切成指定角落，士兵被安顿进每一格。

branches.en: THE GRID: permanent barracks laid out like a checkerboard.
branches.cn: 棋盘格：按格布局的常设营房。

branches.en: THE WINTER QUARTERS: seasonal settling and spring marching.
branches.cn: 冬营：冬季安顿、开春拔营。

branches.en: THE BAZAAR: civilian life crowding just outside the lines.
branches.cn: 巴扎：营区界线外聚集的市井生活。

branches.en: THE ADMINISTRATION: boards and laws that manage the cantonment.
branches.cn: 行政：管理营区的委员会与法规。

branches.en: THE NAMESAKE: Swiss cantons and flag corners from the same root.
branches.cn: 同根近亲：瑞士诸州与旗帜角区出自同一词根。

intro.en: Cantonment is the French verb cantonner plus the noun suffix -ment, the act or place of quartering.
intro.cn: cantonment 由法语动词 cantonner 加名词后缀 -ment 构成，指分驻的行为或驻地。

latinIntro.en: The corner root reaches English through Gaulish, Latin, and French in one long relay.
latinIntro.cn: 「角落」词根经高卢语、拉丁语、法语接力传入英语。

items.exampleCN: 朝各个角落（拉丁语用例示意）。

items.meaningCN: 表示行为、结果或场所的名词后缀

items.meaning: the upper corner square of a flag or shield

items.meaningCN: 被分块驻扎的；被划分的

latinEntries.exampleCN: 角落与边沿（拉丁语用例示意）。
